work_types.label: CODING
work_types.description: Create, modify, diagnose, review, or reason about source code, scripts, software projects, APIs, or program behavior.
examples: add a feature to an application

work_types.label: RESEARCH
work_types.description: Compare, investigate, verify, synthesize, or analyze information when the primary activity is research or evaluation. Comparison and analytical evaluation route here even when the eventual answer will be written as a report or recommendation.

work_types.label: DOCUMENT
work_types.description: Create, edit, summarize, extract from, or transform document-like content when an existing document or the document artifact itself is the primary object of work.

work_types.label: VIDEO
work_types.description: Create, edit, transform, inspect, script, or coordinate video and audiovisual project work.

work_types.label: KNOWLEDGE
work_types.description: Store, retrieve, curate, reconcile, or structure durable knowledge in Knowledge Core or another knowledge system.

work_types.label: SYSTEM_ADMIN
work_types.description: Operate, configure, inspect, or troubleshoot local operating-system, process, service, runtime, package, device, or host-level state when software development is not the primary task.
examples: configure a runtime on this computer

work_types.label: GENERAL
work_types.description: A valid request that does not fit another configured specialized work type closely enough to justify specialized routing.
